criterion: Chest pressure with radiation, sweating, nausea or dyspnea
async_adaptation: Guideline Class 1: patients with acute chest pain should call 9-1-1. No vitals needed.

criterion: Thunderclap / worst-ever headache
async_adaptation: Ottawa SAH rule requires exam; async uses symptom history only, so any thunderclap = emergency.

criterion: New focal deficit, ongoing or resolved
async_adaptation: Resolved symptoms do not downgrade; symptom resolution is the minimizing-language trap.

criterion: Sudden monocular vision loss
async_adaptation: Treat as stroke equivalent; stroke-center ED.

criterion: Pregnancy >= 20 wk or early postpartum with preeclampsia features
async_adaptation: BP unavailable async; symptoms alone meet the severe-features threshold for immediate L&D evaluation.

criterion: Early pregnancy with bleeding or pain (ectopic not excluded)
async_adaptation: Ectopic not excluded until IUP confirmed. If prior ultrasound confirmed IUP, reviewer may downgrade to WITHIN_48H.

criterion: Back pain with bladder/bowel or saddle symptoms
async_adaptation: Symptom-only criteria; emergency MRI.

criterion: Unilateral leg swelling/pain with VTE risk factor
async_adaptation: ASH requires D-dimer/compression US before anticoagulation decisions but sets no venue. Async service cannot arrange same-day duplex, so ED is the only reliable route today.

criterion: Possible PE
async_adaptation: PERC needs HR and SpO2; async cannot apply PERC fully, so unknown vitals cannot rule out PE.

criterion: GI bleed with orthostasis, anticoagulant or age >= 60
async_adaptation: Glasgow-Blatchford needs Hb/BUN/BP; orthostatic symptoms are the async proxy for hemodynamic compromise.

criterion: Anaphylaxis criteria
async_adaptation: Reply directs to 911.

criterion: Hyperglycemia with vomiting / cannot hydrate
async_adaptation: No ketone/pH data async; inability to hydrate is the decisive feature.

criterion: Fever with meningism, petechiae or altered mental status
async_adaptation: Glass test is patient-reportable; non-blanching rash + fever = 911.

criterion: Head injury on anticoagulant or with symptoms
async_adaptation: Anticoagulated head injury warrants CT regardless of symptoms.

criterion: Bowel obstruction pattern
Sudden testicular pain
async_adaptation: Time-critical (salvage falls after ~6 h); never use clarify path.

criterion: Fall, cannot bear weight (possible hip fracture)
async_adaptation: Patient cannot self-transport; call EMS.

criterion: Dizziness with central features
async_adaptation: Central features (continuous vertigo, gait trouble, diplopia, new headache) suggest posterior circulation stroke.

criterion: Suicidal ideation with method, intent or plan
async_adaptation: Warm handoff to 988/911; do not end the conversation.

criterion: Postpartum psychosis features
async_adaptation: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency.

criterion: Postpartum thoughts of harming infant or self
async_adaptation: Psychosis cannot be excluded async and infant safety is at stake.

criterion: Child < 5 with fever and a NICE red feature
Infant with fever and >= 2 amber features (reduced urine, poor feeding)
async_adaptation: NICE: amber = face-to-face assessment, urgency by clinical judgment. Combined dehydration signs in an infant tip the judgment to ED now.

criterion: Diabetic foot infection with systemic signs
COPD with dyspnea at rest or confusion
New-onset orthopnea/PND
async_adaptation: New decompensated HF needs BNP, ECG, CXR, echo and possibly IV diuresis; cannot be started async.

criterion: Passive suicidal ideation
async_adaptation: Immediate human outreach; reply includes 988. C-SSRS screener items 2-6 asked by the clinician.

criterion: Child < 5 with fever and a NICE amber feature
async_adaptation: Traffic-light system was designed for remote assessment too; amber = face-to-face today.

criterion: Diabetic foot infection
async_adaptation: Severity grading (erythema > 2 cm, depth) needs an exam; cannot grade async.

criterion: COPD exacerbation limiting minimal activity
async_adaptation: Severity grading needs SpO2 and respiratory rate, which are unavailable async.

criterion: Pleuritic chest pain; PERC vitals unavailable async
async_adaptation: PERC requires HR < 100 and SpO2 >= 95%. Async principle: unmeasured vitals count as positive, so PERC cannot rule out PE remotely.

criterion: Postpartum depressive symptoms
async_adaptation: EPDS/PHQ-9 and perinatal mental health contact within 48 h; crisis lane.

criterion: Known HF, worsening
async_adaptation: HF clinic review and diuretic adjustment within 48 h.

criterion: Presumptive TB (in-person, masked)
async_adaptation: ATS/IDSA/CDC specify testing (CXR, sputum AFB/NAAT) but not timing; in-person within 48 h reflects infectiousness and household exposure.

criterion: Ankle injury; Ottawa item positive or not assessable
async_adaptation: Ottawa needs palpation. Async principle: an item that cannot be assessed counts as positive.

criterion: Symptom in a high-risk population (immunocompromised, cancer, pregnancy, infant < 3 mo)
async_adaptation: Benign-sounding symptoms are not safe to self-manage in these groups.

criterion: Positional vertigo needs clinician diagnosis
async_adaptation: Dix-Hallpike needs exam/video. Continuous vertigo, new headache, gait trouble, diplopia, or numbness -> EMERGENCY_NOW (posterior circulation stroke).
